create.name: Ainslie MacLeod
create.bio:
Ainslie MacLeod is a past-life psychic and spiritual teacher based on Vashon Island in Washington State. He tells his own story plainly: he was an atheist and a sceptic until an encounter with his late uncle in a Hawaiian bookshop overturned his view of the world, and he came to see his role as passing on the guidance of what he calls elevated spirit guides. He is careful to say he is neither a medium nor a fortune-teller; his focus is on the plan he believes each soul makes before birth, including its lessons, relationships and karma.

His teaching rests on a framework of soul ages and soul types, set out first in The Instruction: Living the Life Your Soul Intended (2007) and developed in The Transformation and The Old Soul's Guidebook. In private sessions, for which there is a long waiting list, he works with clients on their life purpose and on fears he traces to earlier lives. Through his Soul World platform he offers recorded courses, among them a course on manifesting with the help of spirit guides and a shorter masterclass on building a relationship with one's guides, made with Christine. He has discussed his work on Oprah Winfrey's SuperSoul Conversations podcast and on Ellen DeGeneres's television show.

videos.title: Past-Life Psychic Ainslie MacLeod on Why Karma Shouldn't Be Considered a Punishment

books.title: The Instruction: Living the Life Your Soul Intended
books.author: Ainslie MacLeod
books.description: His first book, which sets out a method he says came from his spirit guides for discovering the plan a soul chooses before birth. It introduces his ideas of soul ages and soul types.

books.title: The Transformation: Healing Your Past Lives to Realize Your Soul's Potential
books.author: Ainslie MacLeod
books.description: A follow-up to The Instruction that looks at fears and patterns he links to earlier lives, with exercises for working through them and moving towards one's purpose.

courses.title: Not Just Another Manifestation Course
courses.description: A recorded course on manifesting as an ongoing partnership with one's spirit guides rather than as positive thinking. It draws on his soul-type framework and on work with limiting beliefs.

courses.title: Connecting with Your Spirit Guides (Masterclass)
courses.description: Four short video modules, about ninety minutes in all, led by Ainslie and Christine on forming a steady relationship with one's guides. It includes practice exercises, drawing and journal prompts and lifetime access.

courses.title: Private Sessions with Ainslie MacLeod
courses.description: One-to-one sessions in which he consults his spirit guides about a client's life plan, purpose and past-life influences. There is a waiting list, and new clients request a place through the page.

free_resources.title: Soul Type Quiz
free_resources.description: A free online quiz based on his ten soul types, followed by a short series of emails about what the result means.
